headline: Cocoa-free chocolate goes mainstream; ADM bets on precision fermentation; Red No. 3 deadline
summary: Consumer media now covers chocolate made without cocoa beans, so Belcolade should keep mapping cocoa-free start-ups as partners or competitors while cocoa prices stay volatile.
ADM's CEO named precision fermentation a major innovation driver, signalling a supplier and competitor scaling animal-free proteins relevant to Puratos egg/dairy replacement and cocoa alternatives.

Regulatory: US alcohol producers must drop Red No. 3 by 15 January 2027, a reminder for patisserie customers to finish moving icings and decorations to natural colours; salt substitutes are also gaining policy attention for bread sodium reduction.
A Brazilian study found kefir-whey and traditional sourdough extended bread mould-free life by 40-70% over yeast bread, supporting clean-label sourdough shelf-life claims.
Pea protein (including ultrasound-treated) improved gluten-free rice bread, and a new review covers saturated-fat replacement in bakery, both useful inputs for Puratos mixes and fat-reduction work.

items.title: Your next chocolate bar might not contain a single cocoa bean
items.summary: Consumer news piece on the rise of chocolate made without cocoa beans, reflecting growing cocoa-free alternatives.
items.why: Cocoa-free chocolate is a direct competitive and partnership topic for Belcolade as cocoa prices stay volatile; keep mapping the start-ups behind it.

items.title: Technological potential of a kefir-derived whey fraction as a sourdough starter material for breadmaking
items.summary: Brazilian study testing kefir whey as a sourdough starter; kefir and traditional sourdough breads stayed mould-free about 40% and 70% longer than yeast bread.
items.why: Supports clean-label mould-inhibition claims for sourdough and suggests dairy by-product starters as an upcycled angle for Puratos sourdough ranges.
entities: Federal Institute of Education, Science and Technology of Sao Paulo

items.title: Replacement of saturated fat in bakery products
items.summary: Book chapter reviewing strategies to replace saturated fat in bakery products.
items.why: Overview of saturated-fat replacement options relevant to Puratos fat-reduction work in bread, laminated dough and cakes.

items.title: Sourdough wheat bread: Impact of microalgae supplementation on fermentation metabolism, dough rheology and bread quality
items.summary: Study of how adding microalgae to wheat sourdough changes fermentation metabolism, dough rheology and bread quality.
items.why: Relevant to Sapore sourdough work on protein/nutrient enrichment; microalgae could be a novel functional inclusion to track.

items.title: Improving the quality of gluten-free rice dough and bread: The role and mechanism of native and ultrasonically treated pea protein
items.summary: Study showing native and ultrasound-treated pea protein improves gluten-free rice dough and bread quality, with mechanism analysis.
items.why: Useful for gluten-free bread mixes: ultrasonicated pea protein is a clean-label structuring option to evaluate.

items.title: Focus on flour options to increase chances of product success
items.summary: Trade article on choosing flour options (alternative and specialty flours) to improve snack and bakery product success.
items.why: Signals US industrial bakers' interest in alternative flours, an opening for Puratos mixes and improvers tuned to them.

items.title: Salt Substitutes Can Soon Replace Sodium in Everyday Foods—and Help Lower Blood Pressure
items.summary: Health news that salt substitutes could soon replace sodium in everyday foods to help lower blood pressure, amid US sodium-reduction policy.
items.why: Affects bread makers facing sodium targets; Puratos can position salt-reduction improvers and sourdough flavour as solutions and watch FDA sodium guidance.

items.title: Genomic prediction of resistance to Phytophthora megakarya in cacao from a sparse host-pathogen screen
items.summary: University of Florida-led genomic study of 947 cacao clones and black pod pathogen isolates, showing pathogen genetics improve resistance prediction.
items.why: Better black pod resistance breeding supports long-term cocoa supply resilience relevant to Belcolade sourcing programmes.

items.title: Functional Bakery Ingredients Market To 2035: Clean-Label Demand Supports Forward Growth - News and Statistics
items.summary: Market report forecasting growth in functional bakery ingredients to 2035, driven by clean-label demand.
items.why: Confirms clean-label functional ingredients as a growth area for Puratos improvers and enzymes; useful for market sizing.

items.title: Alcohol Producers Must Remove Red No. 3 From Drinks by Jan. 15, 2027
items.summary: US alcohol producers must remove Red No. 3 (erythrosine) from drinks by 15 January 2027, following the FDA food ban.
items.why: Reminder that Red No. 3 is leaving the US supply; patisserie customers using it in icings, decorations and fillings should confirm reformulation to natural colours.
